correctness.rationale: For every fixed r-set S the probability it stays unseen after t independent k-subset draws is a_S^t, so E(U_t)_r=(v)_r E_{S uniform r-set} a_S^t. Every deterministic k-subset avoids exactly binom(v-k,r) r-sets, hence E_S a_S=binom(v-r,k)/binom(v,k). For integer t>=2 strict convexity proves uniform sampler minimizes every rank r factorial moment. Equality requires every a_S constant. When r<=v-k, double counting complements C=V minus B yields Pr(J subset C)=binom(v-k,j)/binom(v,j) for all j<=r; inclusion-exclusion makes Pr(J subset B)=binom(k,j)/binom(v,j), exactly weighted r-design. Converse also follows by inclusion-exclusion. If maximal strength s<min(k,v-k), first strict difference at rank s+1 for all t>=2. Finite projective planes of any existing order q are 2-designs: all triple avoidance probabilities take a_1=((q-1)^2-1)/v and a_0=(q-1)^2/v with collinear fraction f=(q-1)/(v-2), so strict Jensen gives first discrepant third moment for all t>=2 and t=2 gap q³(q²-1)/(v(v-2)); q=2,3,5 exact rational gap verified fresh. The result concerns factorial moments, not stochastic domination or cover times.
